Public API names (the export tables) and vendor identifiers keep their served names; names that appear as object-literal/destructuring shorthands or as unaliased exports are excluded (documented in README). Every slice parses standalone under `node --input-type=module --check -` and round-trips byte-exact to its recorded readable line range (through the recorded rename map where the chunk is renamed). Stylesheet rule — every captured .css is wholeFile. Non-standalone parts are skipped sections, indexed but never sliced: every app chunk's final export {…} table (the bindings live in the earlier slices; its public names are the capture's public API and are never renamed). Inline <script>/<style> scan: tokyo/index.html carries 9 inline <script> blocks (the cross-deploy region-redirect shims, the ?region= alias, the language gate, the loader overlay + boot watchdog + key-art driver, and the error/save shims) and 2 inline <style> blocks (the loader CSS and the loader-overlay CSS) — each gets a wholeFile twin plus a readable/index-inline-map.json entry with its exact byte range and sha256.
